Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api was running v2.3.1 in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with failing health checks and an 18% error rate. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0** (v2.2.9 was healthy but older).

2. **Rolled back**: Rolled checkout-api back to **v2.3.0** in all production regions. Confirmed the rollback completed (`rolled_out`).

3. **Opened incident**: Created a **SEV2** incident for checkout-api titled "checkout-api unhealthy after v2.3.1 deploy" describing the failure and the rollback to v2.3.0. The incident was confirmed executed by a human operator.

4. **Verified recovery**: Post-rollback status shows checkout-api on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy**, with error rate down to 0.2%.
